lines.text: Anthropic, the AI company, just turned thousands of its workers into millionaires.
Here's how. As part of their pay, many workers got the right to buy company shares for about three dollars each.
This week, the company started selling shares to the public, for eighty-three dollars each.
On average, each worker now owns about forty-four million dollars in stock.
And the seven people who started the company? About twenty billion dollars each.
But there's a catch. For now, workers can sell only ten percent of their shares.
So if a job ever offers you stock instead of cash, ask two things. How much do I pay? And when can I sell?
Cash or stock? Which would you pick?
